patterns.note: Full-width sections with content centered, often using a dark background for high contrast with white typography.
Prominent use of very large, bold sans-serif typography for headlines and brand elements, creating a strong visual hierarchy.

A primary dark grey/black background is consistently paired with white text, accented by a curated palette of muted but distinct colors (gold, purple, dark green, red) used for specific blocks or interactive elements.

A massive, full-viewport brand logo dynamically reveals itself by scrolling down over the hero video, then scrolls up to transition to the next content section, creating a dramatic, scroll-driven brand introduction.
Testimonial sections feature a horizontal carousel with each testimonial presented in a distinct, color-blocked card, using different accent colors from the brand palette.

technique_notes: The site uses scroll-triggered animations (likely GSAP ScrollTrigger, given the hint) to control the reveal and movement of elements. A large, full-viewport brand logo is revealed by scrolling down, appearing to slide over the hero video, and then scrolls up to reveal the next content. Sections also appear to fade or slide in as they enter the viewport. The navigation bar transforms from transparent to a sticky, solid background with a reduced height after initial scroll.
A full-bleed video background with a dark overlay provides context and visual interest, over which a prominent headline and sub-headline are displayed in white for contrast.

A horizontal carousel (swiper) displays client testimonials, each contained within a distinct, subtly rounded card with a unique background color from the brand palette, creating visual separation and interest.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (~3-5x body) contrast with clean, readable body text, with hero text being exceptionally large.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners on buttons, cards, and testimonial blocks, maintaining a soft but not overly playful feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in hero and between major sections, creating a sense of spaciousness, with some tighter grids in feature or testimonial areas.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, scroll-driven reveal and subsequent disappearance of the massive, full-viewport 'BOND' logo, which acts as a dynamic, interactive transition between the hero and the main content. This creates a strong, memorable brand presence and a unique user experience.
